effects: Moves `_amount` of `_token` from the signer to the vault (safeTransferFrom(_sender, address(this), _amount)). The signer must have approved the vault beforehand.

Mints uniBTC to the signer (msg.sender). For a token with 8 decimals the amount equals `_amount`. For a token with 18 decimals it is floor(_amount / 1e10), and the dust below 1e10 wei stays in the vault.
Sends no native value: the function is not payable. It reverts if the token is not allowed or is paused, if the cap would be exceeded, if service is stopped, or if the proof-of-reserve check fails.
formats.shown: "Mint uniBTC by depositing 0.01527466 WBTC", plus the token name and the deposit amount with the token's decimals.

findings.title: mint: the uniBTC amount received is not shown; the contract derives it from the token's decimals.
findings.evidence: VaultWithoutNative.sol _amounts: `if (decs == 8) return (_amount, _amount); if (decs == 18) { uint256 uniBTCAmt = _amount / EXCHANGE_RATE_BASE; ...}`. _mint: `IMintableContract(uniBTC).mint(_sender, uniBTCAmount)`. The descriptor has no field for the uniBTC that arrives, only for `_amount`. In case 0 the signer received 1527466 uniBTC (in), and the screen gives no amount for it.
findings.fix: Optionally add to the intent that uniBTC is minted 1:1 in BTC value (for example 'Mint uniBTC 1:1 by depositing {_amount}'). A tokenAmount field on uniBTC would be wrong for 18-decimal input tokens.

findings.title: mint: for 18-decimal tokens, dust below 1e10 wei is taken but no uniBTC is minted for it.
findings.evidence: VaultWithoutNative.sol _mint transfers the full `_amount`, but uniBTCAmount = _amount / EXCHANGE_RATE_BASE (1e10). The remainder stays in the vault. The descriptor cannot express this.
findings.fix: None needed in the descriptor. A note in the intent such as 'at 1:1 BTC value' covers it.

findings.title: mint: only one test case, an 8-decimal WBTC deposit; no 18-decimal token case.
findings.evidence: cases/0.json uses WBTC (8 decimals). The `decs == 18` branch of _amounts, where the mint ratio differs from the raw amount, is not tested.
findings.fix: Add a case with an allowed 18-decimal wrapped BTC (for example on BSC or another L2 deployment).

cases.notes: The 0.01527466 WBTC sent to the vault is shown correctly. The intent names uniBTC as what arrives, but not its amount: 1527466, 1:1. The reader guessed about 0.01527466.
